transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get the power-management plan sorted for tomorrow's 0800 to 1400 window. We've got three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. I'd like each of you to walk me through your section's requirements so we can build the plan and get it approved. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to flag something before we go further. I confirmed this morning that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000 tomorrow. The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is in the facilities binder, but it hasn't been added to the coordination-board slide yet. That means the facilities shop has a hard requirement on the 0800-1000 block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to add a clinic requirement to the plan. I confirmed with the pharmacy technician that the clinic's vaccine refrigerator must remain on generator-backed power during the exact 1000-1200 block while its primary feed is transferred. This pharmacy note was received after yesterday's clinic report and is not yet in the base power plan, so we need to make sure the 1000-1200 block accounts for this.
